'''D'krn''' was a [[Commander/Legends|commander]] in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Biography==
In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]], [[Commander/Legends|Commander]] D'krn was stationed in the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]], [[Bestine (city)/Legends|Bestine]]. While here, he tasked a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] with retrieving a [[Blood/Legends|blood]] sample from the [[Unidentified Death Watch Overlord|Death Watch Overlord]], [[Overlord|leader]] of the [[Death Watch/Legends|Death Watch]] on the [[Moon/Legends|forest moon]] of [[Endor/Legends|Endor]]. When the spacers inquired as to why he needed the blood, D'krn revealed that it could be used as a [[Clone template/Legends|prime clone]] to create a new and improved batch of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]].<ref name="SWG" />

The spacer agreed to perform the task, and went to [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] for help in gaining entrance to the [[Death Watch bunker]]. Upon gaining access, the spacer and a group of allies killed Viba, and delivered the blood back to D'krn.<ref name="SWG" />

==Behind the scenes==
Commander D'krn is a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|Non-Player Character]] in the [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|MMORPG]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]''. In the game, players may receive a quest from him, which directs them to the Death Watch Bunker of Endor. Though the quest can theoretically be carried out alone, the game mechanics imply that it is optimal to bring a group of other players to help. This article assumes that the spacer working for D'krn killed Teti Viba with the aid of others.
